When Kevin Trudeau got hired as a car salesman with zero experience, he didn't guess how to sell - he found the top three salesmen on the leaderboard and followed them around.

He watched exactly how they greeted people, how they asked questions, and how they listened like they genuinely cared about every answer.

Show real interest, actually listen, and repeat back what someone tells you, and that person starts to trust you before you've sold them anything.

Kevin watched first, copied what worked, and only then started closing deals of his own.
